stories.source: Reuters / White House Rapid Response 47 on X
stories.summary: President Trump posted the real fatal tiger-attack footage from Yorkshire Wildlife Park on Truth Social on Tuesday, captioned 'don't ever mess with nature!', then followed it with an apparently AI-generated video of himself wrestling and befriending the tiger to 'The Lion Sleeps Tonight.' The White House's 'Rapid Response 47' account reshared the footage on X, drawing backlash; victim William Chapman's family urged people to stop sharing it, saying it causes severe distress.
stories.title: Trump posts real tiger-attack footage then an AI video of himself taming the tiger

stories.summary: At OpenAI's annual developer conference, CEO Sam Altman introduced 'Dots,' 'remarkably capable, always-on' AI agents that complete ongoing tasks proactively — a direct rival to Meta's personal agent Muse, which surged after Meta's conference. He also announced GPT-6.1 Sol, an upgraded GPT-6 Sol, and a premium speed tier called 'Ultrafast.' Altman did not address Monday's disclosure that OpenAI is holding off a model release over researchers' security concerns.
stories.title: OpenAI's Altman unveils 'Dots' always-on agents, GPT-6.1 Sol, 'Ultrafast' tier

stories.summary: USA Today filed a $250 million copyright lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging the company copied 'hundreds of thousands' of articles for AI training without permission and that the unauthorized use 'has done real and continuing harm.' Parent Gannett's network of hundreds of local newspapers joins the fight, signaling coordinated media resistance alongside The Intercept, Ziff Davis, and CBC/Radio-Canada — with potential damages now in the billions.
stories.title: USA Today files $250M lawsuit against OpenAI as publishers unite

stories.summary: Brivael Le Pogam, co-founder of French AI company Argil, went viral on Tuesday with an X post warning Americans not to vote Democrat: 'I'm French... I come from your future.' He cited France's public spending at nearly 57% of GDP, no balanced budget since 1974, debt above 3.3 trillion euros, collapsing hospitals despite record funding, declining schools, and engineers leaving for London, Zurich, and San Francisco.
stories.title: French AI CEO's viral X post warns Americans: 'you don't want to be France'

stories.summary: The White House restored the UK's access to advanced AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind before public release, reversing a recent restriction. The move was reported in thejoai's AI news roundup alongside Trump's new AI task force requiring developers to report security incidents.
stories.title: UK regains pre-release access to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI models
